0022600167.text: The Rockets (6-1, 3-0 at home) sit 2nd in the Southwest, half a game back, and 2nd in the West, while the Celtics (4-1, 4-0 at home) are 2nd in the Atlantic, one game back, and 3rd in the East. Houston is without Steven Adams (out, calf strain), and Fred VanVleet and Reed Sheppard are day-to-day with knee and back issues and listed as game-time decisions; Boston is missing Devin Carter (out, illness) and Mitchell Robinson (out, rest). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, and the Rockets lost their most recent meeting 114-93 at home on February 4, 2026.
